title: Injectivity radius from the number of generators
exact_target: Does the number of generators alone bound above the sizes of all embedded balls lying entirely in a hyperbolic three-manifold’s convex core?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300088 (AMR-052-0088). CC BY 4.0.
